SELECT `name`, department, `position`, attendance_date attendanceDate, aed.id, aed.type, aed.actual_start_work_time actualStartWorkTime, aed.actual_end_work_time actualEndWorkTime FROM attendance_exception ae LEFT JOIN attendance_exception_data aed ON aed.exception_id = ae.exception_id WHERE aed.attendance_date in
#{date}

SELECT `name`, department, `position`, attendance_date attendanceDate, aed.id, aed.type, aed.actual_start_work_time actualStartWorkTime, aed.actual_end_work_time actualEndWorkTime FROM attendance_exception ae LEFT JOIN attendance_exception_data aed ON aed.exception_id = ae.exception_id WHERE ae.attendance_month = #{attendanceMonth}

SELECT COUNT(*) count FROM ( SELECT ae.exception_id FROM attendance_exception ae LEFT JOIN attendance_exception_data aed ON aed.exception_id = ae.exception_id
aed.attendance_date IS NOT NULL
AND ae.attendance_month IN
#{item}
AND ae.position LIKE concat('%',#{position},'%')
AND ae.department LIKE concat('%',#{department},'%')
AND ae.`name` LIKE concat('%',#{name},'%')
AND ae.is_verify = #{isVerify}
GROUP BY ae.exception_id ) AS temp
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO attendance_exception_data(attendance_date,actual_start_work_time,actual_end_work_time,type,exception_id) VALUES
(#{item.attendanceDate},#{item.actualStartWorkTime},#{item.actualEndWorkTime},#{item.type},#{item.exceptionId})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE actual_start_work_time = VALUES(actual_start_work_time), actual_end_work_time = VALUES(actual_end_work_time), type = VALUES(type)
